class Edge:
    def __init__(self, to, next, cap, flow, cost):
        self.to = to
        self.next = next
        self.cap = cap
        self.flow = flow
        self.cost = cost

edge = [None] * MAXM

pre = [-1] * MAXN

vis = [False] * MAXN
N = 0

def init(n):
    global N, tol
    N = n

def addedge(u, v, cap, cost):
    global tol
    edge[tol] = Edge(v, head[u], cap, 0, cost)
    head[u] = tol
    tol += 1
    edge[tol] = Edge(u, head[v], 0, 0, -cost)
    head[v] = tol
    tol += 1

def spfa(s, t):
    for i in range(N):
        dis[i] = INF
        vis[i] = False
        pre[i] = -1
    dis[s] = 0
    vis[s] = True
    q = deque([s])

        u = q.popleft()
        vis[u] = False
        i = head[u]

            v = edge[i].to

                pre[v] = i
                if not vis[v]:
                    vis[v] = True
                    q.append(v)
            i = edge[i].next
    return pre[t] != -1

def minCostMaxflow(s, t):
    flow = 0
    cost = 0
    while spfa(s, t):
        Min = INF
        i = pre[t]

            i = pre[edge[i ^ 1].to]
        i = pre[t]
        while i != -1:
            edge[i].flow += Min
            edge[i ^ 1].flow -= Min
            cost += edge[i].cost * Min
            i = pre[edge[i ^ 1].to]
        flow += Min
    return cost
